calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
 SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', sale_date) AS DATE) + 6 AS we, SUM(quantity) AS sold, COUNT(*) AS n
 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-31' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', return_date) AS DATE) + 6 AS we, SUM(quantity_returned) AS ret
 FROM fact_return_line WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND return_date >= DATE '2026-08-31' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.week_ending_date, f.closing_units, f.receipts_units, f.adjustment_units, s.sold, s.n, r.ret,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_stock_week g WHERE g.week_ending_date = f.week_ending_date) AS rows_that_week,
  (SELECT MAX(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_stock_week g WHERE g.week_ending_date = f.week_ending_date) AS maxload
FROM fact_stock_week f LEFT JOIN s ON s.we = f.week_ending_date LEFT JOIN r ON r.we = f.week_ending_date
WHERE f.store_key = 30 AND f.product_key = 11 AND f.week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-31'
ORDER BY 1
